WOODWORK — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.

2. When learning Preparation of Wood, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Preparation of Wood.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Preparation of Wood.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Preparation of Wood.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Preparation of Wood.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

4. When learning Wood Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood Workshop.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Wood Workshop.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood Workshop.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood Workshop.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
